(3) A close-up view of a digital ordering kiosk displays a variety of burgers with prices in Australian dollars. The interface is colorful and high-contrast, showing detailed images of food items. (7) The shot moves to a toilet stall showing several pieces of white toilet paper scattered on the grey tiled floor. (9) A red-walled coffee shop called 'Calvino Coffee' is shown with a barista working behind the counter. (11) The final shots show automotive supplies like engine oil and batteries, followed by a slushie machine and a refrigerated display case containing donuts and pastries.

(2) As the speaker lists various facilities, a short 'ding' sound effect highlights the transition to food pricing details. The vocal intensity remains consistent, conveying a sense of informative discovery. The BGM remains constant in volume and tempo throughout the various visual cuts. (3) The speaker's tone becomes slightly more critical while describing the restroom conditions, with a subtle shift in prosody reflecting observation. The music continues to provide a bright, energetic backdrop without interruption or key changes. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and travel guide, introducing viewers to the facilities and pricing of an Australian highway service station. It aims to provide a comprehensive tour while highlighting cultural and price differences (converted to TWD) for a Mandarin-speaking audience.
